name: HFCL Limited

profile.summary: HFCL Limited manufactures and sells telecom products in India and internationally. The company offers optical fiber cables, such as underground, aerial, microduct, FTTH, and micromodule cables; access solutions, including Wi-Fi access points, network switches, unlicensed band radios, IO canvas unified network management platform, and accessories; IP/MPLS routers; 5G product portfolio comprising access routers/cell site routers and pre-aggregation and aggregation routers; fiber optic cable and copper cable assemblies, high-density cabinets, fiber splice joint closures, ethernet cabling products, and active optical components; and defence solutions, including electro optics, electronic fuzes,
